channel.title: Crypto Readout
channel.description: Crypto Readout reports on Bitcoin, Ethereum and altcoin markets, DeFi protocols, exchanges, stablecoins, network upgrades and crypto regulation worldwide.

item.title: How Many Monero Confirmations Should You Wait For?
item.description: For Monero, wait for 10 confirmations before treating ordinary wallet funds as spendable; deposit services set their own thresholds, so check their rules.

item.title: How to Use PooCoin to Track and Trade BSC Tokens
item.description: Tracking a BSC token starts with its contract address; trading adds a liquidity pool, swap quote and wallet approval, each of which needs a separate check.

item.title: Blackhole swap: How to Price an Avalanche Trade
item.description: A swap quote is an estimate, not a guaranteed fill: check the token pair, network, route and slippage before approving an Avalanche transaction.

item.title: How to Pay Gas When Swapping Tokens on Arbitrum
item.description: On Arbitrum One, swaps use ETH for network gas; learn what the wallet charges, why approvals can cost extra, and how to fund a trade before you swap.

item.title: Ondo launches three BlackRock-designed portfolio tokens
item.description: Ondo has launched three transferable portfolio tokens built on BlackRock strategies, giving eligible investors outside the U.S. onchain exposure to asset baskets.
